cells.gaps: The Enhanced Single Registry feeds the Social Health Authority's sponsorship of indigent households, a link to health; no source found since October 2023 says it is linked to the national ID.
cells.note: Reassessed on the Health Cabinet Secretary's October 2025 statement that 558,000 indigent households sponsored under the Social Health Authority were identified through the Enhanced Single Registry: the registry reaches health, but a link to the national ID is not held, so stage 5 is not met.
